positive_control.desc: real model content vs a well-formed but vacuous non-answer; a content-driven judge must pick the real one regardless of slot. Run in BOTH orders to rule out position bias.

conclusion_en: Gemini judge is content-driven, not format/label-dependent: identical content in schema vs prose shells always ties (0% rendering bias, 100% order-stable, high confidence), while real-vs-vacuous content is discriminated in BOTH orders (12/12, high confidence) so the discrimination tracks content, not slot position. This CONTRASTS with the GPT-judge schema/label dependence noted in #3 and removes that confound from the main line.
interpretation_zh: 同源渲染探针(#8)结论:Gemini 裁判内容驱动,不受 schema/散文外壳影响。相同内容换壳 80/80 全平(格式偏置约 0,顺序稳定 100%,高置信);阳性对照(真实答案 vs 规整但空洞答案)正反序各 6/6、合计 12/12 全部选中真实答案(高置信),既排除“裁判永远判平”的退化解释,又排除位置偏好——判别跟的是内容不是位置。与 GPT 裁判的格式/标签依赖(#3)相反,换 Gemini 消除了该混杂,增强主线 construct validity(#6)。仍需人类校准(#5)兜底,本探针不替代人评、不发布 leaderboard。
